targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "200")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "MPPT_Input_Voltage" or r._field == "MPPT_Input_Current")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, _field: r._field}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.MPPT_Input_Voltage * r.MPPT_Input_Current, _field: "Power"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
